cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Keep the Peace
cards.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave that letter under my plate. Remember how I taught you to get through breakfast without an argument? We only just started eating together again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Has your brother cancelled paying us back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're checking the rent. I've covered it. Next lesson: finish your toast before opening things that upset you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then let me open it after breakfast.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Help me clear up first, like I taught you. You finally unpacked yesterday. Please, I can't face another suitcase in the hall.

reason: Cut the explanation of teaching a peaceful morning into a concrete cleanup request and plainly stated fear, preserving the negotiated delay.
